name: Skill Foundry
description: Learns reusable procedures from tool-heavy conversations and maintains native Evonic skills.
brief: Create and improve reusable native Evonic knowledge skills.
author: Binsar

variables.name: AUTO_REVIEW_ENABLED
variables.label: Auto Review
variables.description: Review opted-in agent conversations after enough tool calls.

variables.name: REQUIRE_APPROVAL
variables.label: Require Approval
variables.description: Keep generated changes pending until an authenticated user approves them.

variables.name: AUTO_ENABLE_GENERATED_SKILLS
variables.label: Auto-enable Generated Skills
variables.description: Enable a generated skill globally after successful materialization.

variables.name: AUTO_ASSIGN_GENERATED_SKILLS
variables.label: Auto-assign to Source Agent
variables.description: Assign a generated skill to its source agent. Requires auto-enable.

variables.name: REVIEW_EVERY_TOOL_CALLS
variables.label: Review Every Tool Calls
variables.description: Accumulated tool calls in one session before a background skill review.

variables.name: TRANSCRIPT_MESSAGE_LIMIT
variables.label: Transcript Message Limit
variables.description: Maximum recent messages read in memory for one review. Transcripts are not persisted by Skill Foundry.

variables.name: REVIEW_MODEL_ID
variables.label: Reviewer Model ID
variables.description: Optional Evonic model ID. Empty uses the source agent model, then the default model.

variables.name: MAX_REVIEW_TOKENS
variables.label: Maximum Review Tokens
variables.description: Maximum output tokens for one review.

variables.name: MAX_RETRIES
variables.label: Review Retries
variables.description: Maximum transport retries for a reviewer request.

agent_settings.name: enabled
agent_settings.label: Skill Foundry Self-improvement
agent_settings.description: Allow automatic review and the Skill Foundry management tool for this agent.
